subject: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@probeai.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, next step is a short MAP that covers: dataset/prompt-pack transfer mechanics, permitted usage (evaluation-only / ephemeral sandbox), retention/destruction timeline, and final close milestones. I attached the initial prompt pack (probing-suite-v1-promptpack.zip) for your engineering team to spot-check.

High-level questions for alignment:
- Is ProbeAI comfortable with evaluation-only access (no production scoring) for 90 days?
- Do you require an IP carve-out for derived model weights or embeddings? Our standard is no model-derivative retention; outputs are allowed for internal evaluation.
- Preferred secure transfer: SFTP or transient presigned S3 link? We can also do an ephemeral GDrive link behind a signed NDA.

Proposed timeline:
1) Aug 1: Redwood delivers prompt pack + MAP draft (attached).
2) Aug 2–3: ProbeAI review & security questionnaire (we'll accept a redline on the MAP).
3) Aug 4: Exchange credentials + sandbox provisioning.
4) Aug 12: Evaluation complete, sign-off or extension request.

If that looks ok, I’ll drop a concise MAP PDF and loop legal for the short MPA/usage addendum.

Thanks —
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: probing-suite-v1-promptpack.zip (zip, 18MB)

From: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@probeai.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@probeai.io>, ProbeAI Legal <legal@probeai.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear steps. A few quick answers from our side:
- Evaluation-only for 60–90 days is acceptable; we prefer 60 days by default but can sign for 90 if needed.
- ProbeAI Legal will want a clause preventing Redwood from using ProbeAI-owned examples for model training. We can accept no-derivative retention for model checkpoints; embeddings/outputs used strictly for internal evaluation only.
- SFTP works best for us (we have a short-lived account process). Presigned S3 links are OK if they auto-expire within 7 days.

Two asks:
1) Can you provide a minimal MAP PDF that we can circulate to Legal?
2) We’ll run the security questionnaire on Monday (Devon will own).

Quick question: Is there a recommended minimum sample-set size you see gives useful signal for your evals?

Thanks —
Sasha
Head of Product, ProbeAI

On attachments: we couldn't open one path in the zip on our Mac; Devon will ping you if anything is corrupted.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@probeai.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Devon Park <devon.park@probeai.io>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline

Nice — thanks for the quick feedback.

Answers inline:
- We can do 60 days if that suits ProbeAI better.
- We will add explicit non-training, non-derivative language to the MAP and to the transfer addendum (no model-weight retention; outputs permitted for evaluation and bug reproduction only).
- I’ll prepare both SFTP and presigned S3 options. If Devon can confirm SFTP username format, we’ll provision.

Suggested sample size: 1,500–3,000 distinct probes (diverse prompts / edge-case variants) gives a reliable quality signal for latency and hallucination rates in our eval kits. If you'd like a smaller quickturn, 300 focused probes can surface major regressions.

Attached: draft MAP PDF (MAP-ProbeAI-2026-08-03.pdf) — short, numbered milestones + usage constraints. Please feel free to redline. I’ll loop Marissa (legal ops & procurement lead) to shepherd any contract steps.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-ProbeAI-2026-08-03.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ProbeAI MAP / security handoff (short note)

Jordan / Karthik —

Quick internal note before we hand this to Legal:
- I reviewed Jordan's draft MAP. Two additions we should include before sending to ProbeAI Legal: 1) explicit destruction confirmation flow (customer to attest within 14 days after eval end), and 2) a limited sync window for audit logs access (redwood will provide request-by-request logs for the evaluation window only).
- For the SFTP path, please include a temporary account TTL (recommended 14 days) and an SCP restriction to the transfer directory. We should also record the SFTP username in the MAP.
- Karthik: can you prepare the SFTP creds template and an ephemeral presigned S3 option? I’ll draft the minimal addendum skeleton for Legal to redline.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@probeai.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline

Sasha / team —

We’ve prepared the secure transfer options and an abbreviated access playbook. Summary: 
- Option A (preferred): SFTP to secure.redwood.ai (port 22) using a short-lived account. Account TTL = 14 days from provisioning. We will scope the account to /incoming/probeai/<deal-id>. SCP/rsync blocked; only SFTP allowed.
- Option B: Presigned S3 object keys that auto-expire in 7 days; downloadable once.

I’ve attached the SFTP credential stub (SFTP-credentials.txt) with the username format (probeai_deal1372_XX) — replace XX with a two-digit counter. Please confirm which option you prefer and the username pattern you want us to create.

On the MAP: we included the destruction attestation clause (agent-signed email required; Redwood will confirm deletion and remove copies from ephemeral caches within 72 hours of attestation).

Next steps / close timeline we are committing to:
- Aug 3: Confirm transfer mode and sign minimal addendum (DocuSign link to follow).
- Aug 4: Transfer credentials & sandbox provisioned.
- Aug 11: Evaluation complete (review call scheduled Aug 12 if needed).

Karthik
Infrastructure Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SFTP-credentials.txt (text, contains username pattern only)

From: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@probeai.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Probing Suite: transfer conditions, usage controls and close timeline

Team —

Thanks — we prefer Option A (SFTP) and the username format looks fine; please provision probeai_deal1372_01. ProbeAI Legal will review the MAP PDF today; Devon will send any redlines by EOD.

We’re aligned on 60 days evaluation per our internal timeline. Once the addendum is in DocuSign we’ll route to Legal+Security. I’ll confirm the final signers (likely two).

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Looking forward to getting the sample set ingested.

Best —
Sasha
Head of Product, ProbeAI

--
